name: Team Charmander: Hyper-Offense & Seismic Supremacy
archetype: Intimidate Water pivots, 4x Grass and Ice artillery, and STAB Earthquake pressure.
gym_duel_rationale: Giovanni relies on heavy physical Ground and Fighting bruisers. When challenged, select your 5 designated Pokémon: Charizard/Venusaur (Ground resistance and 4x Grass STAB to wipe out Rhyperior/Lapras), Gyarados/Nidoking (Intimidate softens incoming hits while Aqua Tail crushes Golem/Machamp), Primeape/Sandslash (devastating dual-STAB Earthquake and Close Combat to shatter Rhydon/Snorlax), Snorlax (unshakable 160 HP normal tank that absorbs hits effortlessly), and Lapras (Ice Beam obliterates Giovanni's Ground hybrids while Water Absorb absorbs Surf).

roster.progression_notes: 530 BST Fire/Grass powerhouse. Resists Fighting and takes neutral from Ground. Neutralizes Rhyperior/Lapras with 4x super-effective Petal Dance and immobilizes threats with Sleep Powder.
515 BST Water/Ground bruiser. Intimidate neutralizes Giovanni's heavy physical hitters on switch-in. STAB Aqua Tail washes out Golem/Machamp and Electabuzz/Dugtrio.
505 BST hyper-fast special sweeper. Outspeeds Giovanni's entire roster and delivers lethal STAB Psychic hits to Primeape/Nidoking and Golem/Machamp.
472 BST physical sweeper. Vital Spirit prevents Rhyperior/Lapras from sleeping it with Sing. STAB Earthquake and Close Combat shatter Giovanni's Rhydon/Snorlax ace.
Colossal 160 HP normal sponge. Absorbs heavy physical punishment, stalls Sandstorm turns with Rest + Sleep Talk, and inflicts paralysis with Body Slam.
535 BST Water/Ice artillery. Water Absorb completely absorbs incoming Surf attacks, while STAB Ice Beam freezes Giovanni's Ground and Flying threats.

flex_bench.rationale: High-Speed Flying scout providing Tailwind team speed doubling.
Levitate provides total Ground immunity while Sludge Bomb poisons opposing walls.
Versatile Fighting coverage with Fire Punch, Ice Punch, and Thunder Punch.
